title: Bahamas guide full route-import rollback
owner_direction: Remove the entire guide-to-member-route bridge and new numeric Route Generator mileage entry. Preserve guide design/content and existing member data. Owner explicitly authorized a small new browser-only calculator after no original public editable calculator could be recovered.

decision.best_fix: Completed surgical removal of importer and numeric mileage feature, restoration of baseline ordinary geometry behavior, and an independent browser-only article calculator.
decision.safest_fix: A narrower hidden/disabled CTA would leave abandoned backend behavior and does not satisfy the owner direction. No alternative retained implementation is recommended.
boundaries: No production deployment or configuration changes

No new account-persistence or route-creation substitute
No hard reset or wholesale commit revert
